title: Download a town map versus exporting your own My Map
summary: Find town-map downloads and distinguish them from your own map exports.

sections.title: Download a high-detail town map file
paragraphs: High-Detail Town Maps provides prepared town-map files in PNG and PDF formats. Sign in with access to My Directory; these downloads are separate from the contents of your own My Maps.
steps: Open High-Detail Town Maps in the dashboard navigation.
Use Search town maps to enter a town name or map code, then find the matching town card.
Check the town and covered areas, preview and PNG/PDF file sizes. Use Wi-Fi if a large download would use too much mobile data.
Select Download PNG for an image or Download PDF for a PDF file, then wait for the browser to start the download.
Check your browser’s downloads and open the file to confirm that you chose the intended town and format.
notes: These are prepared town-map files; they do not add your saved resources, Personal places or private map notes. Downloading one does not create or change a My Map.
For your own mapped resources and layout, open an owned My Map and use Export View or its map export controls. Export Map Assets produces a resource workbook rather than this town-map PNG/PDF.

If search finds no maps, shorten the town name or use Clear search. If the catalogue cannot load, use Try again. If a download fails, check the connection and retry the required format; the preview alone is not confirmation that the full file downloaded.

facts.title: High-Detail Town Maps
facts.message: High-Detail Town Maps are downloadable town-map files in My Directory. They are separate from printing or exporting one of your own My Maps.
